description: This Python module implements a comprehensive subtitle correction pipeline for a media platform. It handles normalization, grammar and style correction, OTT compliance enforcement, and optional audio-aware and transcript-aware harmonization using ASR and fuzzy matching. The code integrates various optional dependencies for enhanced functionality and provides robust handling of diverse inputs, making it a central component for subtitle post-processing in a video platform.

methods.description: Main function coordinating normalization, correction, OTT compliance enforcement, and optional audio/transcript harmonization for subtitle cues.

methods.description: Normalizes input text to a clean, whitespace-normalized string.

methods.description: Applies grammar and spell check corrections using language_tool_python if available.

methods.description: Enforces OTT subtitle standards such as line length, line count, and terminal punctuation.

methods.description: Wraps text into lines respecting max character count and line limits.

methods.description: Aligns subtitle timing and text with provided transcript segments, snapping timings and harmonizing wording.

methods.name: List[Dict] _normalize_transcript_segments(transcript: List[Dict])
methods.description: Converts various transcript formats into a normalized list of segments with start, end, and text.

methods.description: Uses ASR output to correct or harmonize subtitle text, utilizing available ASR libraries.

methods.description: Converts SRT timestamp strings to seconds as float.
